home.subheadline: 20 checks. 100-point authority score. Grade A+→F in 30 seconds.
home.trust: 20 Checks · 100-Point Score · A+→F Grade · 5 AI Platforms
home.scan_error: Could not scan this URL. Please check it and try again.

home.how_subtitle: From raw URL to actionable authority score in under a minute.
home.score_body: Every point is traceable. Core technical checks form the foundation. GEO content checks reward AI-citable writing. Your Authority Engine score calibrates everything to your industry and region.
home.features_subtitle: A complete system for earning and maintaining AI search visibility.
home.authority_subtitle: Each domain you cite — and your own domain — runs through all five layers to produce a calibrated authority score.
home.pulse_title:
Track your brand across
every AI platform
home.pulse_body: Weekly share-of-voice tracking across ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. Every citation recorded is fed back into Layer 5, continuously refining your authority score over time.
home.cta_bottom_body: Paste your URL below. No account required for the first scan.
home.step1_body: Paste your website URL. Optionally select your industry and region for a personalised Authority score.
home.step2_body: 20 checks run instantly. Receive a 100-point score and an A+→F grade across Core, Extended, and GEO checks.
home.step3_body: Download your Fix Pack — llms.txt, a robots.txt patch, and FAQ JSON-LD. Then track weekly with AI Pulse.
home.feature_authority_body: TLD trust → Wikipedia & Tranco signals → Industry pack (13 sectors) → Regional pack (11 markets) → Dynamic learning from real AI citations.
home.feature_checks_body: Core technical (45 pts): robots.txt, llms.txt, bot access, schema, extractability. GEO content (25 pts): citation density, factual density, topical authority, chunkability.
home.feature_citation_body: Scans every external link on your page, scores each source through the Authority Engine, and shows you exactly which citations will earn AI trust.
home.feature_fixpack_body: Three ready-to-use outputs: llms.txt, a robots.txt patch, and FAQ JSON-LD.
home.feature_pulse_body: Weekly share-of-voice tracking across ChatGPT, Google AI, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini. Every citation feeds back into Layer 5 to refine your authority score.
home.feature_intel_body: 13 industry packs × 11 regional packs means your authority score is calibrated to what AI actually trusts in your specific market — not a generic benchmark.
home.personalise_toggle: Personalise — add industry & region for better accuracy
home.layer1_desc: gov · mil · edu · ac · org score higher. Country-code TLDs get regional weight.
home.layer2_desc: Wikipedia presence, Tranco traffic rank, editorial policy, HTTPS, author bylines.
home.layer3_desc: 13 curated industry packs with Tier 1/2/3 domain lists and topical keyword matching.
home.layer4_desc: 11 regional markets: HK, TW, SG, JP, KR, US, UK, EU, AU, CA, Global.
home.layer5_desc: Z-score boost from real AI citation frequency — updated weekly via Pulse.
home.pulse_feedback: Citations feed back into Authority Layer 5

platform.title: Understand your website. Choose what to improve.
platform.summary: Bring website readiness, customer questions and sampled AI answers into a practical review workflow. Start with an observation, inspect its limits and decide your next action.
actions: Run 20 website checks and review the 100-point headline score alongside individual findings.
Use your workspace to organise questions, inspect Pulse samples and prepare editable fixes.
Keep the original finding beside your proposed change so a reviewer can assess both.
platform.evidence: A scan is a dated observation of a single origin page and related checks. Diagnostic pillars overlap; they are views of the findings, not extra points.
platform.limitations: A readiness score is not a search ranking or a promise of AI citations. Discovery and governed agents remain planned capabilities.

platform_site_health.title: Find the website issues you can act on.
platform_site_health.summary: Review crawl access, structured information and answer readiness before deciding what to change on your site.
actions: Start a website scan to inspect 20 checks across core, extended and GEO signals.
Read each finding and prioritise a repair that is relevant to your website.
Review suggested robots.txt, llms.txt and FAQ JSON-LD outputs before applying them yourself.
platform_site_health.evidence: The headline score has a maximum of 100 points. It summarises the current checks; individual findings explain the assessment.
platform_site_health.limitations: Input URLs are normalised to their origin. This is not a crawl of every page, a security audit or proof that an AI provider will use your content.

platform_search_intelligence.title: Build a clearer foundation for search.
platform_search_intelligence.summary: Use website readiness findings to identify technical and content questions worth investigating in your search workflow.
actions: Inspect crawl access and page signals in a website scan.
Separate a technical issue from a hypothesis about discoverability.
Record the change you intend to make and verify the relevant finding afterwards.
platform_search_intelligence.evidence: Current scans assess readiness signals on the evaluated site. They can support a technical review alongside your own search analytics.
platform_search_intelligence.limitations: Live search rankings, Search Console data and search-volume measurements are not provided by this page. A check result does not establish ranking impact.

platform_demand_intelligence.title: Organise the questions your customers ask.
platform_demand_intelligence.summary: Use the workspace question bank to develop and review prompts that reflect your customers, services and market.
actions: Review suggested questions and edit them for your audience.
Group questions by intent and decide which answers your content should support.
Use selected prompts in the existing Pulse workflow when your plan permits it.
platform_demand_intelligence.evidence: Question-bank entries describe the prompts your team chooses to investigate. They help make an observation repeatable and explainable.
platform_demand_intelligence.limitations: Suggested questions are not measured search demand. They do not establish market size, popularity or a complete picture of customer needs.

platform_brand_product_discovery.title: A clearer picture of your brand and products.
platform_brand_product_discovery.summary: Planned: a way to organise brand and product information with its source and review status. This capability is not available today.
actions: Keep factual product information distinct from marketing claims.
Attach a source and review date to each proposed brand fact.
Resolve conflicting information before using it in public content.
platform_brand_product_discovery.evidence: This page describes a proposed direction. It does not display a live entity record, discovery result or verified product catalogue.
platform_brand_product_discovery.limitations: There is no live discovery backend or publishing action here. You can use the existing website scan to review current site readiness.

platform_ai_visibility.title: Inspect AI answers one sample at a time.
platform_ai_visibility.summary: Pulse helps you review sampled answers to selected questions and see where your brand appears in those observations.
actions: Choose relevant prompts and the platforms available under your plan.
Inspect the answer samples and supporting observations for a run.
Compare the context of different runs before interpreting a change.
platform_ai_visibility.evidence: A Pulse result belongs to a particular set of questions and collection conditions. Use the sample context when explaining mentions or omissions.
platform_ai_visibility.limitations: Samples are not global AI rankings or exhaustive provider coverage. Answers can vary, and a brand mention does not demonstrate a sale or causal uplift.

platform_action_studio.title: Turn a finding into an editable fix.
platform_action_studio.summary: Prepare website improvements with the existing Fix tools, then review the output before it reaches your site.
actions: Use a scan finding to choose an appropriate fix output.
Review generated llms.txt, robots.txt patches or FAQ JSON-LD for accuracy and fit.
Apply approved changes through your own website workflow and check the result.
platform_action_studio.evidence: An output is a proposed change based on available inputs. Keep the finding and the edited version together during review.
platform_action_studio.limitations: Generated text can be wrong or incomplete. AISO does not autonomously publish these fixes, and generating an output does not prove it was deployed or improved performance.

platform_governed_agents.title: Keep people responsible for agent work.
platform_governed_agents.summary: Planned: a governed workflow for preparing work within explicit policies and human review boundaries. This capability is not available today.
actions: Define which tasks an agent may prepare and which decisions require a person.
Keep proposed actions, review decisions and external effects distinct.
Make the supporting evidence visible before approving a change.
platform_governed_agents.evidence: These are design principles for a future capability. Existing workspace assistance is not a live policy or approval engine.
platform_governed_agents.limitations: No governed-agent execution, approval queue or autonomous publication is offered here. Existing scans remain available independently.

platform_proof.title: Make reports easier to scrutinise.
platform_proof.summary: Use existing scan findings, Pulse observations and client reports to explain what was observed and what still needs verification.
actions: Review the underlying findings before selecting a report narrative.
Use the existing client report workflow where your plan permits it.
Distinguish an observed result from an explanation or a proposed next step.
platform_proof.evidence: A report communicates the records available to it. Dates, scope and missing observations matter when a reader evaluates the conclusion.
platform_proof.limitations: A report is not independent certification. A delivery-to-outcome ledger and proven causal uplift are not established by the current report workflow.

solutions.title: A review workflow for the way your team works.

actions: Choose the audience workflow that fits your responsibilities.
Start with a website scan and identify one practical improvement.
Agree who reviews the finding and who applies the change.
solutions.evidence: The audience pages describe uses of existing scans, questions, fixes and reports. They do not introduce separate product entitlements.
solutions.limitations: Availability depends on the current plan and feature. An audience label does not imply custom roles, compliance certification or a managed service.

solutions_sme.title: Give a small team a focused starting point.

solutions_sme.limitations: The tool does not replace your website maintainer or guarantee traffic. A higher readiness score is not proof of more customers.

solutions_enterprise.title: Bring website evidence into your existing review process.

actions: Choose a website and define the question your team wants to investigate.

Use existing reports as inputs to your internal decision process.

solutions_regulated_industries.title: Keep evidence and approval in the same conversation.

actions: Identify which website statements require specialist review.

solutions_regulated_industries.limitations: No regulatory compliance, legal suitability or certification is claimed. Do not place confidential or regulated information in prompts without your own approval process.

how_it_works.title: Scan, review, change, check.

actions: Enter your website on the home page and inspect the returned check findings.

how_it_works.limitations: The scan evaluates an origin page rather than every submitted path. Later observations can differ for reasons beyond your change; they do not alone prove causation.

scanPage.title: Scan your website for AI search readiness
scanPage.summary: Run the existing website checks and review a saved result with evidence coverage and collection limits.
scanPage.limitations: A scan is a point-in-time diagnostic. Missing or unavailable collection can leave partial evidence; a successful submission does not guarantee complete coverage or visibility in AI answers.

methodologyPage.title: How to read your scan evidence
methodologyPage.summary: Pillar diagnostics explain the evidence behind a scan. Coverage describes what we could verify; it does not promise rankings, AI citations or business outcomes.

pillars.title: Overlapping pillars, unchanged headline
pillars.body: Pillars group related checks and can overlap: one check may inform more than one pillar. Do not add pillar scores together. The stored headline score, grade and existing scoring weights remain unchanged; pillar diagnostics are a separate interpretation.

coverage.title: Weighted evidence coverage
coverage.body: Coverage is verified observed weight divided by applicable weight. Explicitly not-applicable checks are excluded from both numerator and denominator. Missing, failed, unknown or unverifiable collection stays in the denominator and adds no observed coverage. Ambiguous partial assessment does not count as fully verified. If applicable weight is zero, evidence is insufficient, never a perfect score.

gates.title: Coverage gates before rounding
gates.body: Coverage below 0.67 suppresses the numeric pillar score and shows insufficient evidence. From 0.67 to below 0.85 the score is provisional. At least 0.85 is scored. These decisions use unrounded weighted coverage, even if a displayed percentage rounds up to a boundary. A scored pillar is not a guarantee of complete collection.

history.title: Method versions and historical results
history.body: Newly calculated diagnostics record their methodology version. Stored legacy snapshots retain their original version and are not rewritten. Historical diagnostics recalculated using a newer method are labelled as recalculated; old scans without collection evidence cannot be treated as verified observations. Compare method versions before interpreting differences.

limits.title: Collection and comparison limits
limits.body: Provider outages, blocked requests and missing collection can reduce coverage. Evidence displayed in results is sanitized and subject to access controls. Current redacted, origin-only evidence cannot substantiate an improvement comparison: it does not establish comparable before-and-after measurements. Estimated impact remains an estimate.
